limits: The 138-slot reconstruction is conditional; the source prints 135 slots and advertises 138. No printed cancellation establishes the group movement.
All five minimum destinations 103 through 107 are retained; the primary destination 105 is the start of the final printed row and a printed-group boundary.
The fixed lexical candidate requires three observed-coordinate substitutions, two existing-mask fills and two inserted-slot fills in each tied map. One added coordinate remains unassigned.
The time field is retained as the opaque literal 17?0; its unresolved plaintext position 58 has domain 036OQY under the unchanged complete key. No numerical or clock interpretation selects one label.
Full completion witnesses demonstrate compatibility with one global unchanged key, not the unique historical wording or error mechanism.
